Package dev.px.core.social

Class SocialService

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.social.SocialService
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConfigSection, Named, Service
public final class SocialService extends Object implements Service, ConfigSection
The friend list.

Lives in Core because friendship is a client concept, not a version one: targeting, nametags, chat highlighting and the alt manager all consult it, and every one of those is version-specific code that should not own the list.

It is its own ConfigSection, so friends persist with everything else rather than through a separate file format.
